svg.title: Eleven Core Seats, Thirteen at Scale
svg.desc: diagram id: diag-06-core-and-scaled-pod; chart type: org_architecture; title: Eleven Core Seats, Thirteen at Scale; subtitle: Five employees plus six contractors; add one of each for scale.; chapter number: 11; epistemic tag: operating_framework; assumptions note: Numeric values show core-seat occupancy: eleven values of one and two expansion values of zero. Activating both expansion seats produces 6 FT + 7 C. Contractor seats represent individual capacity commitments, not guaranteed full-time employee equivalents.; caption: Core pod supports the Conservative and Base scenarios; the expanded pod belongs to the Scaled scenario. Verify worker classification from actual working arrangements.; stages: label: FT 1: Owner-manager; value: Core employee seat; commercial accountability; numeric value: 1.0; detail: Own pricing, cash forecasting, jurisdiction selection, insurance relationships, and escalation of contractual disputes outside the field team's authority.; label: FT 2: Estimator; value: Core employee seat; documented scope; numeric value: 1.0; detail: Maintain Xactimate estimates, measured quantities, photo references, and supplement support without negotiating policy coverage or claim settlement.; label: FT 3: Project manager; value: Core employee seat; delivery control; numeric value: 1.0; detail: Schedule trades, manage customer change orders, review daily job costs, and verify completion before milestone billing.; label: FT 4: Mitigation lead; value: Core employee seat; technical field lead; numeric value: 1.0; detail: Direct extraction and drying, maintain psychrometric records, verify equipment placement, and escalate contamination or structural hazards.; label: FT 5: Dispatch and receivables; value: Core employee seat; scheduling and collections; numeric value: 1.0; detail: Coordinate arrivals, maintain authorization records, submit invoices, track aging, and reconcile cleared payments to individual job balances.; label: C 1: Mitigation technician; value: Core contractor seat; extraction capacity; numeric value: 1.0; detail: Perform assigned extraction and equipment handling within documented qualifications and the project's hazard-control plan.; label: C 2: Mitigation technician; value: Core contractor seat; monitoring capacity; numeric value: 1.0; detail: Support moisture monitoring, equipment checks, containment tasks, and removal documentation under the agreed project scope.; label: C 3: Reconstruction carpenter; value: Core contractor seat; demolition and framing; numeric value: 1.0; detail: Execute authorized selective demolition and framing after required hazard assessments, permits, and scope boundaries are established.; label: C 4: Reconstruction finisher; value: Core contractor seat; interior restoration; numeric value: 1.0; detail: Deliver drywall, trim, and finish repairs against measured quantities, approved customer changes, and documented quality checks.; label: C 5: Electrical specialist; value: Core contractor seat; qualified electrical work; numeric value: 1.0; detail: Inspect and restore affected electrical systems within applicable licensing, permit, inspection, and safe-isolation requirements.; label: C 6: Plumbing specialist; value: Core contractor seat; qualified plumbing work; numeric value: 1.0; detail: Address authorized plumbing repairs, record source correction evidence, and separate repair charges from mitigation equipment charges.; label: FT 6: Safety and quality lead; value: Expansion employee seat; core occupancy zero; numeric value: 0.0; detail: Activate at scale to audit hazard controls, training, field records, and rework. Core operations retain these responsibilities before this hire.; label: C 7: Flooring specialist; value: Expansion contractor seat; core occupancy zero; numeric value: 0.0; detail: Activate at scale for substrate preparation and floor installation, with moisture acceptance criteria documented before closing assemblies.
